dependencySecurity.description: Severity grading and response policy for Rust crate dependency advisories sourced from the RustSec Advisory Database and checked via cargo-deny.

severityLevels.label: Critical
examples: cryptographic breaks exposing case data or host filesystem
severityLevels.action: Immediate patch or mitigation merge. If upstream fix is unavailable, ship config-level block with exception and escalate.

severityLevels.label: High
severityLevels.action: Evaluate upgrade path; document exception in deny.toml with expiry no later than 30 days if blocked on upstream.

severityLevels.label: Medium
severityLevels.action: Plan upgrade in next dependency refresh cycle. Document exception if fix still pending at day 30.

severityLevels.label: Low
examples: best-practice violations without a practical attack vector
severityLevels.action: Address during routine maintenance. Exception may be renewed once without escalation.

approvalRequired.critical: pull request with at least one other maintainer review
approvalRequired.high: pull request with at least one other maintainer review

exceptionPolicy.expiryEnforcement: check-deny-exceptions.ps1 fails CI when any exception date has passed

notes: Severity may be raised (never lowered) if the advisory matches a critical data flow in this application.
All exceptions must include owner, expires date, and technical justification.
